newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish-U.S. Przymierze to launch fund next month.
newsitem.headline: Polish-U.S. Przymierze to launch fund next month.

text.p: Polish-U.S. mutual fund company Przymierze Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych SA will start selling units of its first fund, Eurofundusz 1, in September, it said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said it would release further details on September 2.
Przymierze, which won a Polish operating licence in May, is 51-percent owned by Polish state-owned bank Polska Kasa Opieki SA while Alliance Capital Management LP has 49 percent.
Earlier the company's president said Przymierze wanted to launch a family of open-ended funds and that the minimum investment would be no more than 100 zlotys.
Przymierze has capital of six million zlotys and is the fourth asset management company cleared to operate open-ended mutual funds in Poland.
